matched_scene_facts: The scoped area is a channelized work or obstruction area on an apparent urban two-way roadway.
The survey vehicle's forward travel lane remains usable while the channelized area is primarily along the left/opposing-direction side.
The inspection period is daytime, matching the depicted short-duration surveying context.
The posted speed is 20 mph, consistent with a low-speed roadway context.

No accepted detections are available; visual evidence is model-derived and unreviewed.

requirements.candidate_label: Minimum lane width beside center work space
requirements.subject: lane on either side of the center work space
requirements.threshold: at least 10 ft measured from the near edge of channelizing devices to pavement or outside paved shoulder edge
applicability_conditions: TA-16 center-line surveying arrangement is used
a center work space is present

measurement_spec.quantity: clear lane width from channelizer near edge to pavement or outside paved shoulder edge

activation_basis.explanation: TA-16 is selected and the scoped scene is a center-line/channelized surveying arrangement.

requirements.source_span: The lanes on either side of the center work space should have a minimum width of 10 feet as measured from the near edge of the channelizing devices to the edge of the pavement or the outside edge of the paved shoulder.
requirements.inspection_reason: No inspection batch was submitted for this candidate.

requirements.subject: cones used for TA-16 center-line surveying
requirements.threshold: 6 to 12 inches on either side of the center line
applicability_conditions: TA-16 center-line surveying arrangement is used

measurement_spec.quantity: lateral offset of each cone from center line

activation_basis.explanation: The selected TA-16 arrangement expressly governs cone placement around the center line.

requirements.source_span: Cones should be placed 6 to 12 inches on either side of the center line.
requirements.inspection_reason: No inspection batch was submitted for this candidate.

requirements.candidate_label: Channelizer spacing in taper and tangent
requirements.subject: channelizing devices
requirements.threshold: 1 times speed limit in taper channelization and 2 times speed limit in tangent channelization
applicability_conditions: the segment is taper or tangent channelization

measurement_spec.quantity: longitudinal spacing between consecutive channelizing devices

activation_basis.explanation: Activated channelizers and confirmed speed make spacing inspectable; taper/tangent classification is recorded in the field.

requirements.source_span: The spacing between cones, tubular markers, vertical panels, drums, and barricades should not exceed a distance in feet equal to 1 times the speed limit in mph when used for taper channelization, and should not exceed a distance in feet equal to 2 times the speed limit in mph when used for tangent channelization.
requirements.inspection_reason: No inspection batch was submitted for this candidate.

requirements.candidate_label: Downstream extension where devices could lead traffic out of intended space
requirements.subject: channelizing devices with potential to lead vehicular traffic out of intended space
requirements.relation: extend beyond the downstream end of the transition area by
requirements.threshold: 2 times the speed limit in feet
applicability_conditions: channelizing devices have potential to lead traffic out of the intended vehicular traffic space
a downstream transition end is identifiable
required_inputs: potential for channelizers to lead traffic out of intended space

measurement_spec.quantity: device-line extension beyond downstream transition end

activation_basis.explanation: The activated component and confirmed speed support measurement when field inspection confirms downstream leading-out potential.

requirements.source_span: When channelizing devices have the potential of leading vehicular traffic out of the intended vehicular traffic space as shown in Figure 6P-39, the channelizing devices should be extended a distance in feet of 2 times the speed limit in mph beyond the downstream end of the transition area.
